name: duopore-public-order-fulfillment-status
description: See which order lines are complete, partly shipped or still waiting to ship.

interface.longDescription: See which order lines are complete, partly shipped or still waiting to ship. Share ordered quantities, cancelled quantities and shipment records by line ID. Find open amounts, excess shipments and shipment references that do not match an order. This compares your records only. It does not check a courier or change orders.
defaultPrompt: Which order lines still need to ship?
Compare ordered and shipped quantities and flag any mismatch.

positive.prompt: Use Order Fulfillment Status with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"orderLines":[{"lineId":"01","orderId":"001","sku":"A","ordered":5,"cancelled":1},{"lineId":"02","orderId":"001","sku":"B","ordered":2,"cancelled":0}],"shipments":[{"shipmentId":"S1","lineId":"01","shipped":3},{"shipmentId":"S2","lineId":"02","shipped":2}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
